01The gap

The drawing changed. Did the regulatory record change with it?

Engineering records show what has changed in the design. Regulatory records may still describe an earlier configuration. We establish the technical difference, identify the records that depend on it and prepare the questions that require review.

05Follow the connections

One technical change.
More than one record.

A communications update can raise questions across classification, spectrum and licence records. We trace those dependencies.

Proposed antenna change
1 → 3

  1. 01/Dependent record

    Classification record

    Changed technical characteristics — Does the existing record still describe the design?

  2. 02/Dependent record

    Spectrum filing

    Frequency, bandwidth and gain — Which parameters need to be checked?

  3. 03/Dependent record

    Licence conditions

    Scope and operating conditions — Which conditions may depend on the change?

06Contact

Bring the change. Establish the decision path.

Tell us which engineering decision, regulatory filing or programme review is approaching. A high-level, non-sensitive description is enough to begin.

Please do not send controlled technical information through this form. Do not submit classified information, export-controlled technical data, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), proprietary CAD files, source code or sensitive engineering records.
